# Harbor

> Harbor is an AI receptionist offered as a monthly membership for small, growing and large businesses that miss calls: trades, clinics, salons, offices, restaurants and multi-location teams. It answers every phone call in about two rings, 24/7, in a natural human-sounding voice that callers can interrupt. It quotes the business's approved prices, books jobs into the calendar, transfers emergencies live, texts back callers who hang up, and sends the owner a summary of every call.

## Key facts
- Membership: Shore $149/mo (small & solo, 150 calls), Tide $349/mo (growing, 600 calls), Ocean $899/mo (big teams, unlimited). No contracts.
- Promise: if Harbor doesn't catch at least 30 calls you'd have missed in the first 30 days, the first month is free.
- Setup: done for you, live in 48 hours. Keeps the business's existing phone number (call forwarding).
- Always tells callers it is a virtual assistant.
- Can detect the caller's language and reply in it, and adapts to the caller's tone.
